name: The Rise of the Machines
summary: Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania asks you to recover Fractured Elemental Shards in the Burning Steppes. Golems and elementals there may yield what she needs.

sections.title: Theodora's Need
sections.body: Theodora mentions the region's golems and elementals as a source of Fractured Elemental Shards. You are to seek those shards in the Burning Steppes and bring them to the Hierophant.

faq.answer: Hierophant Theodora Mulvadania asks you to recover Fractured Elemental Shards for her.

faq.q: Where are the Fractured Elemental Shards?
faq.answer: The shards are sought in the Burning Steppes, where Theodora recalls golems and elementals as their source.

faq.q: What creatures are a source of the shards?
faq.answer: Theodora recalls that golems and elementals in the Burning Steppes are a source of the shards.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Rise of the Machines
